dependency_edges.handoff: Screened candidate attributes feed K-means imputation.
Filled and normalized attributes feed ROI indices.
One-year ROI history feeds Grey forecasting.
Forecast ROI and risk feed the basic allocation MILP.
Basic decision variables are extended over five years.
The schedule is tested under risk, school-count, and policy alternatives.
Sensitivity and limitations are translated into future data requests and donor communication.

models.computational_cost: The source reports no measured runtime, memory, scaling curve, solver-call count, or implementation cost.

details: Claims are bounded by static school data, subjective indices, five-year Grey extrapolation, and internal MILP comparisons.
Global optimality, solution stability, and practical policy thresholds are not certified.
Source data and formulas are present, but raw snapshots, masks, workbooks, and solver traces are absent.
Imputation, AHP, alpha, Grey forecast, solver, and beneficiary uncertainty are not propagated.

constraints: Preserve rows, units, annual sums, nonnegativity, horizon, count reconciliation, solver identity, uncertainty, and authority.
Do not promote R2, AHP consistency, plots, policy gaps, or one school-count peak to external validation.

models.summary: risk, school count, and annual distribution policies are varied and compared: test internal robustness and practicality
